schema.description: Speech-to-text request input. Accepts a JSON body with input_audio containing base64-encoded audio.

data.description: Base64-encoded audio data (raw bytes, not a data URI)

format.description: Audio format (e.g., wav, mp3, flac, m4a, ogg, webm, aac). Supported formats vary by provider.

language.description: ISO-639-1 language code (e.g., "en", "ja"). Auto-detected if omitted.

options.description: Provider-specific options keyed by provider slug. Only options for the matched provider are forwarded; the rest are ignored. Unrecognized keys are silently dropped.

response_format.description: Output format. "json" (default) returns { text, usage }. "verbose_json" additionally returns task, language, duration, and segment-level timestamps; only supported by OpenAI-compatible providers.

timestamp_granularities.description: Timestamp detail levels to include when response_format is "verbose_json". "segment" returns segment-level timestamps; "word" additionally returns word-level timestamps in the words array. Ignored unless response_format is "verbose_json".

items.description: A timestamp detail level for verbose_json transcription responses.

file.description: The audio file to transcribe. The format is derived from the filename extension or the file part content type. Max 25 MB; send larger files as base64 JSON via input_audio.

language.description: The language of the input audio (ISO-639-1).

model.description: The model to use for transcription.

response_format.description: The response format. "json" (default) returns { text, usage }; "verbose_json" additionally returns task, language, duration, and segment-level timestamps (OpenAI-compatible providers only).

timestamp_granularities[].description: Timestamp detail levels to include when response_format is "verbose_json". "word" additionally returns word-level timestamps in the words array.

example.text: Hello, this is a test of OpenAI speech-to-text transcription.

example.text: Hello, this is a test of OpenAI speech-to-text transcription.

duration.description: Duration of the input audio in seconds, present when response_format is verbose_json

language.description: Detected or forced language, present when response_format is verbose_json

segments.description: Timestamped transcript segments, present when response_format is verbose_json

items.description: A timestamped transcript segment, returned when response_format is verbose_json

avg_logprob.description: Average log probability of the segment

no_speech_prob.description: Probability the segment contains no speech

task.description: The task performed, present when response_format is verbose_json

text.example: Hello, this is a test of OpenAI speech-to-text transcription. The weather is sunny today and the temperature is around 72 degrees.

usage.description: Aggregated usage statistics for the request

cost.description: Total cost of the request in USD

input_tokens.description: Number of input tokens billed for this request

seconds.description: Duration of the input audio in seconds

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used (input + output)

words.description: Timestamped words, present when the provider returns word-level timestamps

items.description: A timestamped word, returned when the provider includes word-level timestamps
